blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Token source and security docs expose per-account freezing, forced transfers and global pause. At the pinned Ethereum, Arbitrum and Monad blocks, the issuer address held FREEZE_MANAGER_ROLE and FORCED_TRANSFER_MANAGER_ROLE on every deployment. Terms section 11 applies freezing, seizure, forfeiture and potential destruction to all holders, not only eligible counterparties.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: All three deployments can issue native MoonPay liabilities and transfer them using M0 Portal burn/mint with the LayerZero V2 adapter. Exact route identities and Portal administrator membership are verified; validator sets, route limits and complete Portal upgrade/signature safeguards remain unresolved.
